- [Incognito Mode](https://gdplabs.gitbook.io/glchat/application-ui/how-to-guide/navigation-and-chat-list/incognito-mode.md): Incognito Mode is designed for temporary conversations. It allows you to use GLChat without saving the conversation to chat history or showing it in the chat list after the session ends.
- [Guest Mode](https://gdplabs.gitbook.io/glchat/application-ui/how-to-guide/navigation-and-chat-list/guest-mode.md): Guest Mode allows users to access project without logging in, enabling quick, temporary interactions while maintaining data privacy and session isolation

- [Interactive Agent Responses](https://gdplabs.gitbook.io/glchat/application-ui/how-to-guide/chat-input-and-responses/interactive-agent-responses.md): Agents in GLChat can display interactive components such as forms, cards, buttons, or guided actions when configured with A2UI.

# Agent Instructions
This documentation is published with GitBook. GitBook is the documentation platform designed so that both humans and AI agents can read, navigate, and reason over technical content effectively. Learn more at gitbook.com.

## Querying This Documentation
If you need additional information, you can query the documentation dynamically by asking a question.
Perform an HTTP GET request on a page URL with the `ask` query parameter:
```
GET https://gdplabs.gitbook.io/glchat/overview.md?ask=<question>
```
The question should be specific, self-contained, and written in natural language.
The response will contain a direct answer to the question and relevant excerpts and sources from the documentation.
Use this mechanism when the answer is not explicitly present in the current page, you need clarification or additional context, or you want to retrieve related documentation sections.
